subject.title: [Bug]: Skill Workshop agent-tool apply times out because approval wait exceeds tool watchdog

question: Should maintainers make https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100498 the canonical fix for this Skill Workshop approval timeout cluster, or land the narrower timeout-only https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/91325 instead?
rationale: Current main still has the bug and both open PRs close this issue, but the broader PR changes approval metadata and timeout semantics while the older PR widens the Codex watchdog instead.

options.title: Review and land the broad approval fix
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100498 as the canonical path because it fixes the timeout at the Skill Workshop approval boundary and also addresses the linked popup-detail and large-proposal reports.

options.title: Land the narrow Codex timeout fix
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/91325 if maintainers want the smallest change and are willing to leave approval copy, proposal metadata, and timeout-result behavior to follow-ups.

options.title: Keep both PRs paused for approval-design review
options.body: Pause both candidates if the desired lifecycle approval contract is still unsettled across chat channels and owner approval evidence.

recommendation.title: Review and land the broad approval fix
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100498 as the canonical path because it fixes the timeout at the Skill Workshop approval boundary and also addresses the linked popup-detail and large-proposal reports.

likelyOwner.reason: This account is assigned to the issue and authored the broader open candidate that closes this issue and the nearby Skill Workshop approval reports.
